gain_ramp.rule: linear ramp; each end matches 20 ms RMS outside the cut

seam_qc.seam_rule: click <= 3x clip p99.9, energy step <= 8 dB, F0 ratio <= 1.12

provenance.method: splice of the donor's vowel with a 10 ms crossfade and gain ramps; Praat TD-PSOLA overlap-add, donor re-synthesised on the source F0 contour (source pitch 150-500 Hz, donor analysis 70-300 Hz, 150 ms margins)

cross_backend.method: int8 exact engine vs fp32 ONNX vs fp32 ONNX with fp16-rounded initializers, streamed like the engine, CAL reference scorer, default presets
cross_backend.npu_method: (tensor: t7f.tflite on TFLite CPU kernels; e2600: Exynos 2600 emulator with the board LUT tables); CAL reference scorer, fp32 thresholds, default presets

rules.tokens: identical greedy tj3 tokens on the clean clips (planted clips: flags only)
rules.flagged_sites: identical set at the default site preset, every clip
rules.flagged_words: identical set at the word block's default preset, every clip
rules.finite: no NaN or inf in any head
rules.on_failure: not promoted; retried only for a new model revision or OS build
